summary: Ballard Power Systems closed its acquisition of GeoPura, a UK hydrogen power solutions provider. Upfront consideration totaled £275.0 million, comprising £82.5 million in cash and 49,584,212 newly issued Ballard common shares plus restricted share units, with an additional 1,084,540 shares to be settled in 12 months. Former GeoPura shareholders hold roughly 14.1% of Ballard on a pro-forma basis. Up to £27.5 million in contingent consideration is possible upon milestone achievement. The deal integrates GeoPura's Hydrogen Power Units and Energy-as-a-Service model with Ballard's fuel cell technology, expanding Europe and North America presence. Ballard CEO Marty Neese commented; GeoPura's Andrew Cunningham became Ballard's President. Watch integration execution and milestone-based earn-out.
